name: Up the Hill Down to the Nevermind
source:
A lonely and depressed hikikomori grapples with their existence and transgender identity in a world where delusion begins to intertwine with reality. What once was good is now lost and all that's left is memory- but how reliable is your memory?

[Edited from [url=https://prairieland.itch.io/nvm]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一個孤獨而憂鬱的蟄居者，苦苦思索自己為何存在，以及該如何面對自己的跨性別身分。與此同時，妄想與現實開始交織。昔日的美好已然失落，留下的唯有記憶。可你的記憶，究竟有多可靠？

［編譯自[url=https://prairieland.itch.io/nvm]itch.io[/url]］
